note: EB3-A/B/C/D (plan U7-2). ONE declaration of the CI layers, read by scripts/eb3-ci-required.mjs. This file is the Required-ness claim; the workflows are the implementation. A job declared here that no workflow provides is CI_REQUIRED_JOB_ABSENT; a workflow job nobody declared is CI_JOB_UNDECLARED. Neither direction may be silent: an undeclared job can be deleted by the next tidy-up, and a declared-but-absent job is a merge gate that does not exist. Layers are reusable workflows called ONLY by the aggregate (mustRunOn=workflow_call): one caller, one run, one result — a standalone pull_request trigger would double-run every layer and expose it to GitHub's pending-run cancellation inside a shared concurrency group. Each layer's `legs` name the CONCRETE invocation it must perform (cmd + required flags + forbidden flags), not a word to look for: a leg satisfied by an echo, a step name, a shell comment or a weaker flag set is not a leg. `hostFree` declares whether the layer may list a suite that resolves the pinned host checkout; eb3-ci-required refuses a host-dependent suite in a hostFree layer (CI_HOST_DEPENDENT_SUITE_IN_HOST_FREE_LAYER).

aggregate.note: The synthetic merge-tree summary. `synthesize` builds the merge of base+head with git merge-tree (no ref moved) and fails hard on a conflict; `ci-required` runs if:always(), needs every layer below, and is the ONE Required branch-protection context. `jobs` names both so the undeclared-job rule stays honest about the summary's own jobs. Every entry in the summary's needs must be a declared layer or the checker reds: a layer left out of needs can fail while the summary stays green.

deferral.label: ci-defer-full
deferral.note: THE DEFERRED TIER. An intermediate fix-round push may carry the PR label `ci-defer-full`; the ci-full caller is then skipped. The Required job `ci-required` is NEVER skipped (a skipped required job reports skipped, which branch protection accepts as passing) and still needs ci-full, so a skipped ci-full grades red there: a deferred run cannot satisfy branch protection. `required-deferred` (check name `ci-required-deferred`, not Required) grades the other layers so the round still gets a verdict. The ci-full caller may carry exactly `callerIf` and nothing else; the deferred job may never be named ci-required. The head frozen for review must run with the label removed and the full aggregate green.

legs.why: Raw census captures (~3.8 MB) were committed into tracked evidence scratch/ three times in two days with only a prose rule against it (PR #396 untracked 32 MB; lanes re-committed 6-8 each). Refuses files the PR ADDS under dev/agent-workflow/evidence/ that match the raw-capture/resample grammar, or exceed 1 MiB without a reasoned entry in dev/ci/evidence-large-allowlist.json. --new-since is required: without a base it would grade against origin/master, which is not the merge ref's first parent.

PR #404 merged with its live C2 RUN record at overall=FAIL (u7f:inspect-list / u7f:refusal-zero-effect / u7f:approval-leg FAIL) while every layer was green: nothing machine-checked 'the definition passes' against 'the real positive effect ran on a Host'. This leg grades dev/agent-workflow/ledgers/u7-tool-acceptance.json — one row per claimed tool, four levels (definition / mounted / refusal / positive), every PROVEN level backed by a committed RUN record case PASS. DISCLOSED and NOT_VERIFIED never fail it: honesty is the merge gate, completeness (every L4 PROVEN) is the G5 release gate.

EB4-B/D/E tooling (PR #394) shipped in no CI layer, so a real tool defect (integration-order dropped committed evidence and read untracked files) and a checkout-shape-dependent test (E2) went uncaught. These are node:test suites, not vitest, so they cannot ride a suiteList (eb3-security-run is vitest-only); they are a leg. Host-free: no HOST_DEPENDENCE_MARKERS, the only host reach (devex verify-zero) is not exercised; ci-integration checks out with fetch-depth 0, which E4/E5/D11 need for origin/master.
